# Screenshot Plan — Structurizr DSL Plugin

## Screenshots

### 1. Syntax Highlighting
**Title:** Rich Syntax Highlighting for Structurizr DSL
**What to capture:** A `.dsl` file open in the editor showing colorized keywords, strings, comments, identifiers, and `${}` variable substitutions. Use a workspace with multiple elements and relationships to show variety.

### 2. Code Completion
**Title:** Intelligent Context-Aware Completion
**What to capture:** The code completion popup showing suggestions for elements, keywords, or properties. Trigger completion inside a `systemContext` view to show element suggestions.

### 3. Navigation and Structure View
**Title:** Navigate Your Architecture with Structure View
**What to capture:** The Structure View panel open on the right showing the hierarchical tree (workspace → model → views → elements) alongside the editor with a breadcrumb bar visible at the top.

### 4. Code Inspections
**Title:** 9 Inspections Catch Errors Before Rendering
**What to capture:** The editor showing highlighted errors (red underline for undefined reference, yellow for unused element) with the inspection tooltip visible and a quick-fix suggestion.

### 5. Live Diagram Preview (Pro)
**Title:** Real-Time C4 Diagram Preview
**What to capture:** The split editor view with DSL code on the left and the rendered C4 diagram on the right. Show a system context diagram with people, systems, and relationships.

### 6. Multi-Format Export (Pro)
**Title:** Export Diagrams as SVG, PNG, PlantUML, or Mermaid
**What to capture:** The export dialog open with format options visible (SVG, PNG, PlantUML, Mermaid). Show the context menu or Tools menu entry for exporting.

### 7. Live Templates
**Title:** Quick Scaffolding with 10 Live Templates
**What to capture:** The live template expansion in action — type `ws` + Tab showing the generated workspace scaffold with placeholder cursor positions.

### 8. Find Usages
**Title:** Find All References Across DSL Files
**What to capture:** The Find Usages panel at the bottom showing all references to a selected element across one or more DSL files.
